hook: This guard is about to show you why soldiers faint.
tiktok_caption: Why soldiers faint when they stand still too long. Lock still, or wiggle your toes: which keeps you on your feet? Your calf muscles squeeze your leg veins and one way valves push blood back up to your heart. Stand frozen and that muscle pump stops, blood pools in your legs and less reaches your brain. Anatomy and physiology, venous return. levlprep.com #anatomy #physiology #nursing #science
yt_title: Why soldiers faint standing still (the muscle pump)
yt_description:
Why soldiers faint when they stand still too long. Lock still, or wiggle your toes: which keeps you on your feet? Your calf muscles squeeze your leg veins and one way valves push blood back up to your heart (the skeletal muscle pump). Stand frozen and that pump stops, blood pools in your legs and less reaches your brain (Anatomy and Physiology, blood pressure and venous return).

Free A&P notes and practice on blood pressure and flow: https://levlprep.com/anatomy-physiology/notes/blood-pressure-flow.html?ref=yt-guard-faint
pin_question: Have you ever felt lightheaded after standing still for a long time?

hook: Australia brought in about a hundred cane toads to save its sugar cane, and it backfired badly.
tiktok_caption: Cane toads in Australia, the invasive species that backfired. Did the toads save the sugar cane, or take over the country? They couldn't reach the cane beetles, poisoned the animals that ate them, and had almost no predators or diseases to hold them back, so they spread across northern Australia. AP Environmental Science, invasive species. levlprep.com #APES #environmentalscience #canetoads #ecology
